transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well… I’m here because there’s been a pattern in my building for months. The property manager, and a few others, they’ve been using things like misdelivered mail, noises in the walls at certain times, comments from neighbors… to push me out of my apartment. They give explanations, paperwork, whatever, but it doesn’t change what’s happening.
Have there been times recently when you felt unusually high, energized, or euphoric?
No… I wouldn’t say euphoric. I’ve been alert, I guess, because of what’s been going on, but not unusually high or anything like that.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?
No… not really. I mean, I hear things in the building sometimes, but not voices like that when I’m alone.
Do you believe anyone is controlling your thoughts?
No… I don’t think my thoughts are being controlled. That’s not really how I’d put it.
Aside from what you believe is happening with your neighbors and property manager, have you noticed any other unusual experiences or changes in yourself?
I don’t know. Nothing besides that, really… not that I’ve noticed. I’ve just been more careful, that’s all.
Do you think it’s possible you might be mistaken about your neighbors and property manager trying to push you out?

I’ve considered it, but… no. Not really. When the mail keeps getting “misdelivered,” and the noises in the walls happen right on cue, and then neighbors make those little comments… it adds up. The paperwork and explanations don’t change the pattern I’m seeing.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say most of the day. I’ve been preoccupied, but “depressed” isn’t really the word I’d use.
About how long have you been convinced that your neighbors and property manager are trying to push you out of your apartment?
About… 11 months, I guess. It started not long after I moved into the new apartment.
Has anything happened that makes you believe your neighbors or the property manager can do things that would be impossible in ordinary life?

Impossible? No… I’m not saying they’re doing magic or anything. It’s more that the mail gets misdelivered, the noises in the walls happen at just the right times, and people make these little comments. The manager’s paperwork doesn’t really explain that pattern to me.
Outside of this situation with your neighbors and property manager, have you been able to manage your usual day-to-day life normally?

Yes. I mean… generally, yes. I pay my bills, cook for myself, keep appointments. I can talk through consulting work or my painting just fine when that apartment issue isn’t in the middle of everything.
When you talk with other people, have they told you that your speech is hard to follow or doesn’t make sense?
Not really. I mean, some people say I’m too detailed or I repeat myself, but… I don’t think they’ve said I don’t make sense.
Have you noticed yourself becoming less emotionally expressive than you used to?
I don’t think so. I’m not… especially expressive to begin with, maybe, but I haven’t noticed some big change that way.
Have you ever heard voices speaking to you or about you when no one was there?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed anything like voices when no one’s there.
Has anyone told you that your behavior became very disorganized or hard to understand?
No… not that I’m aware of. People might not always agree with what I’m doing, but I don’t think anyone’s said it was disorganized or hard to understand.
Since this started, has your work suffered because of it?

Some, yes. I’ve stepped back from a few consulting jobs. I end up spending a lot of the week checking with neighbors or offices, building staff… things like that, instead of just doing my regular work or painting.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
I don’t know… I still like the things I like. I just haven’t had as much time or focus for them lately.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were being broadcast so that other people could know what you were thinking?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t had the sense that people can hear my thoughts or anything like that.
Have you ever felt that thoughts were being put into your mind by someone or something outside you?

No. Not put into my mind, exactly. It’s more that there’s a pattern around me—the mail going to the wrong place, noises in the walls at certain times, comments from people in the building. It feels like pressure to get me out of the apartment, but my thoughts still feel like mine.
Have you had the feeling that someone or something was controlling your body or causing sensations in it?
No… I can’t say I’ve felt that. My body feels like my own. I haven’t noticed anything like someone controlling it.
Do you believe your neighbors or the property manager have any special ability to know what you are doing inside your apartment when they could not normally know it?

I don’t know if I’d call it a special ability. But they seem to know enough. Things happen right after I do something—noises in the walls, mail ending up wrong, little remarks from people downstairs. It’s been going on for months. The explanations don’t really account for the pattern.
